description: The WHEN DFHPF3 arm of the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :184-195, second of its three arms. :188 moves 'COMEN01C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN transfers, so no map is sent and no record is emitted. RECEIVE-TRNRPT-SCREEN has already run at :183, so the map's values are in the buffer - they are simply never painted, which is why this case pins no send. The AID is declared as the DFHAID mnemonic and resolved through common.PfKeyResolver, whose PF3-to-PFK03 fold this program's inline EIBAID test must agree with. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED by reading app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl, its copybooks, app/bms/CORPT00.bms and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD - never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible in this environment (risk R-A). Java has no transient data queue, so EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') at :517 is reproduced through an explicit job-submission port; the eighty-byte content is identical and the dataset key JOBS names the TDQUEUE(JOBS) that app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:499-505 defines as RECORDSIZE(80) RECORDFORMAT(FIXED) BLOCKFORMAT(UNBLOCKED) DISPOSITION(MOD).
